title: Mae - packed crew animation strip
why: Make the quartermaster readable in the existing crew sprite family.
acceptance: Exactly one atlas region named dw_crew_mae, 280x20 pixels, with binary transparency and only the listed palette names.
Preserve the large head, tiny right-facing eye, projecting nose, compact body and soot outline of the supplied existing-character reference.

An original elderly woman quartermaster, short silver-gray hair with one small tucked braid shape, bone utility vest over muted brown sleeves, dark brown belt and tiny square hip pouch, olive-gray trousers, dark boots. No glasses or handheld props.
No blur, antialiasing, fractional scaling, rotation, gradient pixels or isolated export specks; inspect at 1x and nearest 8x.
All 20 cells fit 14x20 with stable head, feet and accessories: idle 0-1; walk 2-5; sit 6; work 7-8; guitar 9-10; coffee 11-12; clean 13-14; hammer 15-17; carry 18-19.
Feet remain on the existing actor baseline with no clipping, unexpected pose jitter or missing tool/hand silhouettes.
notes: An original elderly woman quartermaster, short silver-gray hair with one small tucked braid shape, bone utility vest over muted brown sleeves, dark brown belt and tiny square hip pouch, olive-gray trousers, dark boots.
